title: HB-01 lowest-vertex audit
method: NodeIO read of shipped GLB bytes in apps/ui-xr/public/generated-humanoids; per-primitive world minY via node world matrix; glTF up axis is +Y so minY is the sole height (card names Blender-scene bmin.z; both mean the boot sole). Grade-engine note: finished_figure_grade.choose_grade_engine falls back to BLENDER_WORKBENCH which ignores Principled Base Color; record the engine before any colour finding.
causeStatement: No shipped GLB exports the MPFB Icosphere; no openclinxr_hidden_* cover shell is the global minimum in any body. 17 of 19 bodies have the footwear mesh as the global minimum. The 2 exceptions are VISIBLE bare-skin sole vertices below embedded slipper shells, not invisible helpers. The 158px float in the published still is therefore NOT reproduced by the GLB bytes: it came from the Blender-side unparented Icosphere at z=-1 already fixed in 8f615ceb, not from exported geometry.

bodies.exceptionReason: bare-skin sole vertex of anny_base (x=-0.154,z=0.233,y=0.0) sits 14.9mm BELOW the hospital-slipper sole (y=0.0149); slippers are embedded shells around feet, not full soles. Offending geometry is VISIBLE skin, not a helper shell; no Icosphere or hidden shell sets the minimum in any GLB.

bare-skin sole vertex of anny_base (x=-0.109,z=0.166,y=0.0) sits 9.2mm BELOW the hospital-slipper sole (y=0.0092); same embedded-shell cause as above. Offending geometry is VISIBLE skin; no Icosphere or hidden shell sets the minimum in any GLB.
